result: Completed bounded discovery; fixed Qwen MLX candidate warrants further review, not production admission.
scope: Seven previously selected public FLEURS clips; three unchanged note/hotword arms each. Full archived production PCM, not prepared WAV. Direct offline candidate only: no note-save UI, production ASR worker, translation, minutes writer or user workspace exercised.

candidate.component_policy: Independent optional component; not bundled with installer.

initial_observer_failure.reason: Observer expected one prompt construction. The pinned release builds the same prompt again only to count tokens. The first request returned internally, but its text was not emitted or inspected before repairing the observer.
initial_observer_failure.repair: Exactly one instrumentation-only repair; count actual chunk calls and require two identical prompt/token observations for nonempty output. Preserve raw output before parent-side rejection. Fixed-source AST stub checks pass without a model. No changed weights, runtime, decoding, notes, inputs or quality rules.

limits.gpu_memory_policy: Record MLX active/peak separately; do not equate unified-memory metrics with process-tree RSS.

generation.hotwords_source: Exact recorded wire.words for each arm; passed directly as generate(hotwords=...)
generation.pcm_conversion: numpy.frombuffer(bytes, dtype=<i2).astype(float32) / 32768.0; no normalization, resampling, trimming, padding or second PcmReader pass.

findings.remaining_unhinted_name_error: 013 still mistranscribes Oldrich Jelinek as Aldrich Deleñic in baseline/positive and Ondrej Deleňic in negative. Passing target-name sentinels is not complete factual fidelity.
findings.wer_limit: Existing token scorer unchanged: 11th/16th versus written ordinals, punctuation and tokenization may contribute errors. Numeric source-fidelity controls are independent of aggregate WER.

limits: Discovery selection contains known small-model misses and only seven English clips; not representative accuracy, Chinese/mixed-language coverage, original Q9 100-case admission, or Q16 minutes quality.
No clip contains spoken negation; checks only unexpected explicit insertion, not preserving spoken negation or uncertainty. Other unhinted names still fail.

Historical small baseline used source a6afb8e61f7cf34191a77999067635ff66dc44a9 and archived output, not a current-source or matched lifecycle speed comparison. Raw output and old textual correction remain distinct.

Warm import/OS/Metal caches; sampled CPU is a lower bound. Summed process RSS can double-count sharing and excludes parts of GPU/unified allocation. MLX allocator peaks are separate and must not be added to or substituted for RSS. No energy or whole-meeting resource improvement claim.
Direct model hotwords can inform recognition, but this run does not implement or validate notes triggering safe automatic acoustic revision of existing transcript and minutes.
decision: Keep current production defaults and Q9/Q16 gates unchanged. Continue a bounded optional Apple Silicon component evaluation; no installer bundling.

Before automatic refinement, verify full original name/negative/numeric corpus and Chinese/mixed speech. Preserve human revisions, archived ASR and an explicit latest accepted acoustic baseline so later note edits cannot restore obsolete first-pass text.

Schedule any future refinement only within explicit idle/resource/time budgets and cancel on changed notes, source, recording or meeting identity. Commit transcript/citations atomically only with supporting audio evidence; do not use name presence alone to justify replacement.
Retain one pinned task-owned model/runtime for the next approved-scope evaluation rather than download duplicate copies. No application model installation or signed release component was created.
